active_plays.action_plan:

active_plays.description: Tempo-grounded IFVG reversal model. Direction-aware confluence (8 short + 8 long factors), 7 anti-pattern hard skips, regime-gated by opening range and prior-day character. 5yr backtest 2021-2026, OOS-validated, walk-forward stable in 53% of 6-month windows at PF ≥ 1.5.

active_plays.name: VP Magnet Play (A+) — n_vp≥2 + VA-Edge
active_plays.action_plan:
Watch 30s + 1m + 2m + 3m simultaneously 9:30-10:15 ET. On EVERY FVGC fire from ANY TF: 1) variant must be bos, ifvg, or no_fvg (NOT PS); 2) n_vp_targets >= 2 (POC/VAH/VAL in trade direction within 0.5R-3R); 3) direction-matched VA-edge ahead (VAL for long, VAH for short within 0.5-3R); 4) within 9:30-10:15 window. All YES from ANY TF -> take at 1.5x size, stop -1R, fixed TP +3R, no BE. SUBSEQUENT same-day same-direction fires on slower TFs are re-confirmations only -- already in trade, no action. Median gap between first and second fire when multi-TF triggers same direction: 2.5 min, 65% within 5 min.

Exit Strategy: Stop −1R (FVG geometry). Fixed TP +3R. NO BE move (BE clips runners — see RM section). Max consecutive losers in 9yr sample: 2. Max yearly DD: −2R.
active_plays.pre_market_conditions: Compute prior-RTH (9:30-16:00 ET previous session) POC, VAH, VAL from 30s NQ candles (1.0 pt buckets, 70% value area). Levels are KNOWN by 4:00pm ET the prior day. By 9:30 you should have a printout: POC=, VAH=, VAL=__, and where current price sits relative to them.

active_plays.name: IFVG Reversal — v3 (anchor-to-sweep + close entry)
active_plays.wr_base: 71.0% @ 1R | 65.2% @ 1.5R | PF 2.81 (n=138 signals across 37 distinct opps — v3 re-run on TV-aligned bars)
active_plays.action_plan:
LONG only. Killzone 9:30–11:00 ET. Entry TF: 3min (winner). Sweep (wick-through, wick_only strictness) of a major liquidity level. PD gate ON — entry must be below prior-day mid. Within 10 bars, a bearish 3-bar FVG forms whose NEAR EDGE (bottom) is anchored to the swept price: abs(fvg_bottom − sweep_price) ≤ 3 × fvg_size (no proximity cap). The sweep candle itself can be bar k of the 3-bar pattern. Entry = CLOSE of the first bar (within 2 bars of FVG formation) that closes back above the FVG top. No retest. Stop = FVG bottom − 5pt. Chop filter ON (skip if ≥3 bars sit inside the FVG before inversion). Obstruction filter ≤3.

Exit Strategy: 1.5R full close. PF 2.81 on this target (buffer=5pt on stop). WR@1R=71.0%, WR@1.5R=65.2%, avg_r=+0.630. Move stop to BE only after the first 10–20pt internal swing in profit — never tighter. Soft stop: full candle body close back through entry.
active_plays.pre_market_conditions: Mark: 1H swings (unswept), 4H swings (unswept), London H/L, Asia (overnight) H/L, 6am H/L, prior-day H/L/MID, NY AM rolling H/L (9:30 onward). On red-folder 8:30 news days, mark the 1-min news candle H/L if range ≥60pt. Primary confluence driver (re-run): instant_inversion=True (inversion happens within 1 bar of FVG formation, not 2) — WR 84.0% at n=50, +23.8pp lift. Secondary: large-bucket FVG sizes (bucket 6+, ~15pt+). Note: unlike the pre-fix run, swing_1H is NOT a significant confluence factor here.

active_plays.name: VWAP Continuation
active_plays.action_plan:
1. Session-anchored VWAP from 9:30. 2. Wait for 3+ consecutive 30s closes above (long) or below (short) VWAP. 3. Pullback within 2pt of VWAP. 4. Entry: first 30s close back on trend side. 5. CRITICAL: measure abs(entry - VWAP). If <10 NQ pts → skip this signal. 6. R0 = abs(entry - VWAP at entry). 7. No new entries after 10:00 ET. Multiple signals/day allowed.

Exit Strategy: Initial SL = first 30s close on wrong side of current VWAP (dynamic). Move stop to BE when +1R reached. TP = fixed +2.5R from entry. Three outcomes: WIN +2.5R (37%), BE 0R (47%), LOSS variable avg -1.3R (15%). PF 4.61 / EV +0.73R. The BE move at +1R is non-negotiable — without it, PF collapses to ~1.1.
active_plays.description: Anchored VWAP from 9:30, 3+ trend bars, pullback within 2pt, re-cross entry in gap-aligned direction, ONLY when R0 (entry-to-VWAP distance) ≥10 NQ pts. Exit: dynamic VWAP-close SL → BE at +1R → TP at +2.5R. 8yr revalidation 2018-2026: n=313, PF 4.61 raw / 4.13 after 0.5pt slip, EV +0.73R/trade (~$217/contract). Profitable every year incl. 2025 (+$19K/ct). Original 'Calm VIXY only' filter was wrong and has been removed — high-VIXY days actually have the highest PF.

active_plays.name: ATR Range Exhaustion Filter (High VIXY)
active_plays.wr_base: 61% at 1R (high VIXY + <30% range used + W1, n=124) | 58-61% across window variants
active_plays.action_plan:
At FVGC entry signal: compute range_used_pct = (session_high_so_far – session_low_so_far) / rolling_40d_avg_rth_range. Only take the trade if range_used_pct < 30% (strict) or < 50% (looser). Entry must be W1 (9:30–9:45). Skip if >100% of expected range already used.

Exit Strategy: Standard FVGC exit (1R TP, SL at swing). No modification needed — the filter is pre-trade context only.
active_plays.description:
On high VIXY days, take FVGC entries at W1 (9:30–9:45) when <30–50% of the expected daily ATR range has already been used by session open. Expected daily range = 40-day rolling average of prior rth_range. Range used = (session_high – session_low) from 9:30 to entry bar / rolling_avg_rth_range.

This is a FILTER on top of the base FVGC model, not a standalone signal. It selects the subset of W1 FVGC trades that occur early in high-volatility sessions when most of the day's expected range still remains.
active_plays.pre_market_conditions: Check VIXY regime: must be 'high'. Compute expected daily range = 40-day rolling avg of prior rth_range. This is your denominator for the range_used_pct filter during the session.

active_plays.name: 15m FVG Breakout Continuation
active_plays.action_plan:
1) Price breaks through a 15m FVG — closes on the far side (non-reclaiming). 2) Within 10 bars (30s TF), an opposing-direction FVG created before the break gets inverted (close crosses its far boundary). 3) First FVGC signal in the SAME direction as the break fires within 40 bars of the inversion. Entry must be 09:30–10:15 NY. KEY DIFFERENCE from reversal study: trade direction matches the break direction, not opposite.

Exit Strategy: BE@1R → TP 3R (or hold to 5R: PF 8.33)
active_plays.description: Price breaks through an unmitigated 15-minute FVG — the gap fails to hold. An opposing FVG that was supporting the prior structure gets inverted, confirming the break is real. Then a FVGC signal fires in the breakout direction (continuation, not reversal). This is a momentum play: when 15m structure fails, the move runs hard. Median MFE 8.7R. Only works on 15m FVGs — tested all level types, nothing else comes close.
active_plays.pre_market_conditions: Identify unmitigated 15-minute FVGs on the chart. These are potential breakout levels if they fail to hold.
active_plays.frequency: ~23/yr (~1.9/mo) | ~1 every 10 days (median) | longest typical wait 38 days. NOTE: play status REJECTED — DO NOT TRADE.

active_plays.name: FVGC To Opening Range H/L
active_plays.action_plan:
1. AT 9:45: mark OR.H, OR.L. If OR > 150pt → NO PLAY. 2. From 9:45-10:15, watch 30s bars. 3. On each FVGC: (a) variant != ifvg, (b) direction points at unswept OR side, (c) at least one OR side still unswept → TAKE IT. 4. SIZING: 1st fire = 1x. 2nd-4th = 0.5x. Skip 5th+. 5. Same-day re-entries have SAME edge as #1 (Trade #2 PF 1.73, #3 PF 1.89, #4 PF 2.00) — take them, half size for risk control. 6. Target 2R, hold SL. Day done when both OR swept OR 10:15.

Exit Strategy: Target = 2R. Hold ORIGINAL SL through any OR retest. Do NOT move to breakeven — 70-85% of OR touches retrace through entry before continuing; a BE stop gets hit. Data: of trades that touch the OR target, 72-83% blow through it to 2R; only 10-16% reverse. The runner past OR is where the edge concentrates. Avg excursion beyond OR target on continuations: +6R.
active_plays.description: After 9:45, take 30s FVGCs pointing at an OR side that has NOT been swept yet. Target 2R, hold original SL. Kill switches: OR > 150pt | variant = ifvg | both OR sides swept | magnet-against | 5th+ trade of day. SIZING: 1st of day = 1x, 2nd-4th = 0.5x half. 8.2yr validated: n=995, PF 1.79, EV +0.40R/trade. Sized R/yr = +39.6 = $23,780. Monthly: 74.5% winning months, worst -5.5R, Sharpe 0.75. NO VIX FILTER (tested, p=0.057 — not significant). The sized rule alone provides risk management.
